name: helix-discord-bot
description: HELIX Universal Discord Bot & AI Dashboard with self-contained zero-cost SQLite database

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Heroku application name (automatically injected by Heroku during deploy)

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal (Bot tab -> Reset Token)

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Discord Application Client ID (General Information -> Application ID)

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Discord OAuth2 Client Secret for dashboard login. Optional for bot-only mode.

DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL.description: Base OAuth2 URL (leave empty to automatically use https://<app-name>.herokuapp.com)

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public NextAuth URL (leave empty to automatically use https://<app-name>.herokuapp.com)

NEXT_PUBLIC_INVITE_URL.description: Administrator Discord bot invite URL (leave empty to automatically generate from Client ID and Heroku domain)

CLONE_CLI.description: Set to 'true' to clone and install the HELIX CLI into .cli/ so the bot can run /helix slash commands. Leave empty to run standalone.

NEXTAUTH_INTERNAL_URL.description: Internal connection URL (defaults to http://localhost, dashboard auto-binds port)

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for signing NextAuth sessions (generated automatically)
